commit_message:
[Merged] [json] Parser: Add more checks for fast-iterable keys

We didn't check all the required properties for fast iterable keys in
the JSON parser. Some of these properties are only relevenat for
JSON.stringify, but nevertheless need to be checked in the parser before
we mark a descriptor array as fast iterable.

Fixed: 414962716,415551707

[json] Parser: Fix updating FastIterableState

When the last key of an object didn't match the feedback, we incorrectly
still updated the fast iterable state.

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 0d56aee89ab6 on top of intro 5fdab0114d12 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: In commit 5fdab0114d1 (`[json] Parser: Add more checks for fast-iterable keys`), the `kJsonUnknown` branch of `ParseJsonObjectProperties` was restructured. The old code had an explicit `return true;` for the no-more-properties case after a mismatch, but the new code omitted it inside the `if (V8_UNLIKELY(is_slow || !key_match))` block. The `kJsonFast` branch (in the same function) correctly had `return true;` in the equivalent location, but the newly written `kJsonUnknown` branch did not, leaving `++idx` reachable when it should not be.
